description: This file contains Go source code implementing functions for parsing and handling OpenAPI v3 schemas, including reference resolution, schema parsing, and schema type handling within the Kubernetes kube-openapi project.

methods.name: NewOpenAPIV3Data
methods.description: Creates a Models object from an OpenAPI v3 Document, parsing schemas and references.

methods.name: ParseV3SchemaReference
methods.description: Resolves a schema reference, returning a Schema object or error.

methods.name: ParseV3SchemaOrReference
methods.description: Parses a schema or reference, returning a Schema object or error.

methods.name: ParseSchemaV3
methods.description: Creates a walkable Schema from an openapi v3 schema, dispatching based on schema type.

methods.name: parseV3Kind
methods.description: Parses an object schema with properties into a Kind schema.

methods.name: parseV3Arbitrary
methods.description: Parses a schema as an arbitrary schema type.

methods.name: parseV3Primitive
methods.description: Parses primitive schema types like string, number, integer, boolean.

methods.name: parseV3Map
methods.description: Parses map schemas, verifying object type and additional properties.

methods.name: parseV3Interface
methods.description: Decodes a YAML node into an interface{}.

methods.name: parseV3BaseSchema
methods.description: Constructs a BaseSchema object from an openapi v3 schema.

methods.name: SpecificationExtensionToMap
methods.description: Converts OpenAPI specification extensions to a map[string]interface{}.
